data.name: Mingus
data.detailed_description:
Play a simple co-op after work/study with friends

This is beta test. Just 3 clicks to create a lobby where you can plan how to clear the planet from the evil Minguses. And yes, you can invite not only friends but also strangers🐔

Minguses?

The former inhabitants of the planet discovered the “Magic Yogurt,” which allowed them to grow fruits and vegetables quickly and efficiently. But they didn’t notice that the food became sentient, united, and wiped them out. These mutated fruits and vegetables are called Minguses. They took over the planet and now rule it. Funny, but extremely aggressive creatures.

Throw props at the Minguses

It’s simple: you and your friends just grab crates, barrels, even each other, and throw them at the Minguses. But be careful — these mutated fruits and vegetables are not as simple as they look.

Your goal – reach the end of the level

You progress through a chapter of 10 levels in Co-Op mode, where your task is to wipe out all Minguses and reach the end. At the finish, it’s a 50/50 chance: an arena or a boss. Except at level 10… there’s something dangerous waiting. Each level is unique thanks to procedural generation.

Magic Cat and Hub

Between levels, you appear in a safe Hub location where a magic cat sells you items. You earn coins by completing side quests and destroying Minguses.

Don’t just use the Grabber

There are also PowerUps that give you different abilities. You can set traps that can catch Minguses — or your teammates. And you can also fire stratagems.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 650 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Only runs on 64 bit systems
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i5 or Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or RX 470 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Only runs on 64 bit systems
